standard_position: Either party may terminate on 60 days' written notice.
red_flag_triggers: Unilateral termination right for counterparty only, or notice under 30 days

standard_position: Termination for uncured material breach after a 30-day cure period.
red_flag_triggers: No cure period, or cure period over 60 days

standard_position: Liability capped at 12 months of fees paid or payable; mutual; excludes indirect and consequential loss.
acceptable_range: Cap of 12 to 24 months of fees
red_flag_triggers: Unlimited liability for our side, cap below 6 months of fees, or one-sided cap

standard_position: Mutual indemnity for third-party IP infringement and breach of confidentiality; capped by the liability cap.
acceptable_range: Mutual; may be uncapped only for IP infringement
red_flag_triggers: One-sided indemnity, or broad first-party indemnity for all losses

standard_position: Mutual obligations for 3 years after termination; standard exclusions.
red_flag_triggers: Perpetual for all information, or no exclusions, or one-sided

standard_position: Each party retains pre-existing IP; deliverables owned by the client on full payment.
acceptable_range: Licence instead of assignment for vendor tools
red_flag_triggers: Assignment of our pre-existing IP, or vendor owns all deliverables

standard_position: Net 45 days from invoice receipt; late interest not exceeding 1% per month.
red_flag_triggers: Net under 30 days, or late interest above 1.5% per month

standard_position: Laws of India; courts at Mumbai; arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act as an option.
acceptable_range: Any Indian jurisdiction; neutral arbitration seat
red_flag_triggers: Foreign law or foreign courts without neutral arbitration

standard_position: Processor obligations, breach notification within 72 hours, deletion on termination.
red_flag_triggers: No breach notice, no deletion obligation, or free transfer abroad

standard_position: No assignment without prior written consent, except to affiliates or on merger with notice.
red_flag_triggers: Counterparty may assign freely while we cannot

standard_position: Renewal only by written agreement; any auto-renewal needs 60 days' opt-out notice.
red_flag_triggers: Auto-renewal for multi-year terms with under 30 days' opt-out

standard_position: Mutual relief for events beyond reasonable control; termination right after 60 days.
red_flag_triggers: One-sided relief, or no termination right
